newsitem.title: UK: UK's ITC clears United News merger.
newsitem.headline: UK's ITC clears United News merger.

text.p: The Independent Television Commission (ITC) said on Thursday that it had cleared last year's merger between United News & Media and MAI Plc.
The ITC said that the deal, which brought United's newspaper interests and MAI's ITV television franchises under common ownership, "could not be expected to operate against public interest".
United News owns The Express and Daily Star national newspaper titles plus a number of local newspapers. It also operates ITV franchises for eastern and southern England.
The merger was agreed early in 1996 and was considered by the ITC under new rules given to the watchdog when the Broadcasting Act 1996 became effective on November 1.
